notes: Next Greater Element I is an easier monotonic stack warmup for Trapping Rain Water.
Daily Temperatures is an easier monotonic stack problem before attempting Largest Rectangle in Histogram.
Next Greater Element I teaches the fundamental monotonic stack pattern used in Daily Temperatures.
Daily Temperatures teaches monotonic ordering needed for maintaining deque maximums in Sliding Window Maximum.
3Sum extends Two Sum using an outer loop with two-pointer convergence.
Two Sum II teaches the sorted two-pointer subroutine used inside 3Sum.
Two Sum II solves Two Sum on sorted input using two pointers instead of a hash map.
Valid Palindrome introduces converging two-pointer inward stepping used in Container With Most Water.
Trapping Rain Water and Container With Most Water both calculate bounded areas between vertical height lines.
Valid Anagram introduces character frequency counting used as group keys in Group Anagrams.
Contains Duplicate teaches hash map frequency construction before finding Top K Frequent Elements.
Contains Duplicate introduces hash set lookups needed to identify streak starts in Longest Consecutive Sequence.
Product of Array Except Self uses prefix/suffix scans similar to complementary element lookups in Two Sum.
Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock introduces tracking a dynamic left boundary in a window.
Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters teaches variable window expansion and contraction.
Minimum Window Substring generalizes the sliding window technique from Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters.
Character Replacement teaches window validity checking with character frequencies before tackling Minimum Window Substring.
Binary Search is required to master search space halving before attempting Search in Rotated Sorted Array.
Binary Search is required to identify inflection boundary conditions in Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array.
Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array isolates the rotation inflection point of Search in Rotated Sorted Array.
Koko Eating Bananas applies binary search on the answer space rather than over an explicit input array.
Merge Two Sorted Lists builds on pointer manipulation and dummy nodes introduced in Reverse Linked List.
Linked List Cycle introduces two-pointer fast/slow traversal over singly linked lists.
Climbing Stairs establishes the fundamental 1D DP recurrence needed for House Robber.
Climbing Stairs teaches building optimal solutions from previous subproblems before tackling Coin Change.
Coin Change extends 1D subproblem minimization with multiple coin transition choices similar to House Robber.
Climbing Stairs introduces optimal substructure needed for Longest Increasing Subsequence.
Longest Common Subsequence generalizes the 1D subsequence recurrence of LIS to a 2D grid comparison.
Maximum Subarray (Kadane's algorithm) is closely related to tracking running window extrema in Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock.
Number of Islands teaches graph traversal before handling cycle detection in Course Schedule.
